geometry_annotations.summary: Retained FL-606 coastal water/island redraw in 2023
geometry_annotations.text: FL-606's 2022–2023 GIS redraw removes about 37.44 km2 and adds 60.66 km2 along the coast and islands; it persists in 2024. Census 2020 area-water polygons classify about 94.7% of the removed footprint as water. Land-area population weighting indicates small resident-population sensitivity but does not locate homeless people or beds. The redraw is retained as provisional cartographic maintenance by study-owner decision. The PIT increase from 462 in 2022 to 703 in 2023 has not been established as a boundary-transfer effect. Published PIT/HIC counts, the approved city repair and study membership are unchanged.
